question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

To enter unlawfully upon the land of another
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 1 i.e. (Trespass)'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase 'To enter unlawfully upon the land of another' can be replaced by the word "Trespass". 
 
• "Trespass" refers to the act of entering someone else's property without permission.(अवैध प्रवेश)

Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Trespass'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "Delinquent" (अपराधी) refers to a person, typically a young one, who has a tendency to commit a crime.
 
• "Transgression" (उल्लंघन) means an act that goes against a law, rule, or code of conduct.
 
• "Culprit" (दोषी) refers to a person who is responsible for a crime or other misdeeds.
